title: Timetable
pupil.label: Person
tomorrow.heading: Tomorrow
tomorrow.freeTomorrow: Tomorrow is free - this is the next school day.
tomorrow.noneHint: Nothing is scheduled in the next three weeks. Enter the weekly timetable and this view fills in.
week.heading: Week {{range}}
week.emptyHint: This week is empty. The timetable repeats - entering it once covers every week.
edit.heading: Weekly timetable
edit.caption: Recurring lessons. A change here applies to every week.
edit.hint: Tap a cell to enter subject, room and teacher. For a single day - a substitution, a trip, a cancelled lesson - use an override in the shift planner.
edit.cellHint: Applies to every week. With no subject, room or teacher the period becomes free.
edit.noPlan: No timetable for this person yet
edit.noPlanHint: The timetable is a 7-day pattern. Create it and it can be filled cell by cell.
edit.noPeriodsHint: A timetable needs periods with a time. Create them in the shift planner or run this module's setup.
colors.heading: Subject colours ({{count}})
colors.hint: One colour covers every lesson of the same subject. With no choice of your own, a subject gets a colour worked out from its name - the same one on every device.
colors.newField: The first time you pick one, the timetable creates the field Farbe in the shift planner - that is where the colour is stored.
colors.failed: The colour could not be saved
days.heading: School days ({{count}})
days.hint: Which days the timetable shows. This choice applies to this device - what annoys you on the phone may be fine on the kitchen computer. The plan itself does not change: a hidden day keeps its lessons.
days.hidden: Careful: {{days}} still carries lessons ({{subjects}}). They are no longer shown, but they stay in the plan.
days.lastOne: One day has to stay - a timetable without columns would not be one.
times.hint: Applies to every week and to all seven days. The times belong to the period, not to the day.
times.required: A start and an end are both needed.
times.order: The end must be after the start.
setup.heading: Set up the timetable
setup.intro: Setup creates what is missing - anything already there is kept and found again:
setup.periods: Six periods from 08:00 to 13:15 as shift types (times can be changed later in the shift planner)
setup.fields: The fields subject, room, teacher and colour
setup.readOnly: No write access to the shift planner - the timetable can be viewed but not changed.
setup.partial: Done, with one limitation: the fields are not attached to {{periods}} yet. Edit a cell of those periods and the editor will catch up.
field.subject: Subject
error.load: The timetable could not be loaded
widgets.free: No lessons in the next three weeks.
